subject: Novalytics pilot top-up / conversion microgrant request
messages:
From: Elliot Harper <elliot.harper@novalytics.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot top-up request — we need a small boost to close

Hi Stephanie,

Quick one — the pilot has traction but we’re bumping against token limits in the last validation sprint. We’ve hit 78% of the success criteria (intent recall and throughput), and the product team wants one more week of load testing with a larger sample.

Can Redwood provide a short-term top-up / trial extension (tokens or credit) to cover another ~60k tokens over 7 days? If we can run the extra tests this week, we expect to sign an expansion contract in Q1.

Attached is the latest metrics snapshot and a short note on outcomes we’ll measure. Appreciate any way to make this smooth — timeline is tight (end of week).

Thanks,
Elliot
Product Lead | Novalytics
[Attachment: novalytics_metrics_Q4.pdf (pdf)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot top-up request — we need a small boost to close

Folks — forwarding Novalytics request. TL;DR: 60k token top-up for 7 days, high likelihood to convert to an expansion ARR in Q1 if tests complete.

Proposed offer (sales-side):
- One-off conversion microgrant: 60k tokens (hosted API) issued as credit, valid 7 days.
- Condition: must complete agreed A/B validation and provide the post-test metrics set in attachment.
- No change to pricing table; this is a one-time incentive tied to Deal DEAL-8721.

Why this matters: they’re past the POC inflection point; legal/compliance check is low risk, and the expected ACV > $120k ARR. If finance signs off I’d like to reply with the terms and propose a short MPA addendum.

Attachments: conversion_microgrant_terms.docx, approval_matrix.xlsx

Can you review and confirm whether finance can approve one-off credits for this deal? Need sign-off by EOD Friday to meet their testing window.

— Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot top-up request — we need a small boost to close

Thanks Steph. Quick Qs before I escalate to finance:
- Is the 60k tokens estimated gross or net after normal discounts?
- Any legal/data residency exposure from the additional runs?
- Do we want to attach a conversion clause (credit applied if they sign within 90 days) or just a pure one-off?

If you can add the answers I’ll push to finance.

— Rishi

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Elliot Harper <elliot.harper@novalytics.ai>, Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@novalytics.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 13:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot top-up request — we need a small boost to close

Hi Rishi — answers inline below and I’ve attached an updated terms doc.

- Token count: 60k gross (hosted API tokens). We’re proposing credit for usage up to 60k; anything beyond billed normally.
- Data residency: Novalytics is using our US region only; there’s no new data flow or export. Legal reviewed the sample logs and flagged nothing unusual.
- Conversion clause: propose hybrid — credit is one-off, but if they sign within 90 days we convert 50% of the credit into a first-year billing credit (applies to invoice after expansion). That gives them runway while protecting unit economics.

I added an approval matrix row for who signs at which threshold (see approval_matrix.xlsx). If finance okays, I’ll send a short MPA addendum and schedule the credit issuance.

Elliot / Sara — if you’re good with the hybrid approach I’ll get the paperwork out today.

— Steph
[Attachment: conversion_microgrant_terms.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot top-up request — we need a small boost to close

Okay to proceed with the hybrid conversion clause. Two asks before final sign-off:
1) Add a hard usage window (7 days) in the addendum and an explicit post-test deliverable (metrics snapshot + short comment from Novalytics PM).
2) Add a simple fallback: if tests are incomplete by the end of the week we cancel the credit.

If Rishi confirms finance, I approve this from GTM. Good win if they convert.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 14:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot top-up request — we need a small boost to close

Finance reviewed the attachment and the approval matrix. Approving one-off credit: 60k tokens as an account credit, hybrid conversion clause as proposed. Conditions: credit expires 7 days after issuance, and conversion credit (50%) only applies if a signed SOW or contract is accepted within 90 days. No other concessions.

Steph — you’re clear to send final addendum and issue the credit once Novalytics countersigns the MPA.

— Rishi
Finance Approver | Redwood Inference
